text: When selection among services depends on manipulable, non-contextual signals the selected party controls, the market for services clears on claims rather than on outcomes.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7314479

isBasedOn.name: Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes

abstract: Self-reported capability, static ratings, installation counts, and volume metrics are each manipulable, and none is contextual. A component that performs well on one class of task and poorly on another carries a single undifferentiated score, if it carries one at all. The consequence is that the market for services clears on claims rather than on outcomes.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: service selection driven by self-reported or volume-based signals
